text.p: Standard Microsystems Corp said Wednesday it expects improved performance from its component products division for the second quarter ending August 31 compared to the fourth quarter of fiscal 1997.
The company also said it expects improved performance from the second quarter compared to the current first quarter.
The company said order-input rates for the component product division have recently increased.
The company also said it expects its operating loss for the first quarter of fiscal 1998 ending May 31 will be significantly less than its operating loss for the fourth quarter ended February 28.
The company said it had anticipated the higher level of new orders would have little effect for the current fiscal quarter.
The company reported a fourth quarter net loss of $19.5 million, or $1.40 per share, compared to a profit of $26.4 million, or $1.94 per share, for the same period a year ago.
The company said these fourth quarter revenues reflect significantly lower revenues in both ints consumer products division and and its systems products division.
